info.title: TetraFi Price API
info.description:
Real-time pricing WebSocket for TetraFi RFQ trading. Streams order book levels
(bids and asks) for all available token pairs on a given chain.

## Connection

Connect via WebSocket to `wss://api.tetrafi.io/pmm/{chain}/v3/pricing` with
your API key in the `Authorization` header as a Bearer token
(`Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`).

## Message Format

Messages are delivered in Protocol Buffers format.

## Update Frequency

Price updates are published approximately every second. Each message contains
the full current state of the order book for all pairs.

gasless.description: Set to true to receive gasless pricing (longer expiry, TetraFi submits tx).

expiry_type.description: Quote expiry window. Short expiry gives tighter prices on some chains.

Authorization.description: Your API key as a Bearer token: `Bearer <API_KEY>`.

receivePriceUpdates.description:
Receive periodic price snapshots for all available token pairs.
Each message contains the full order book state in Protocol Buffers format.

ProtobufPriceUpdate.name: ProtobufPriceUpdate
ProtobufPriceUpdate.title: Price Update (Protobuf)
ProtobufPriceUpdate.summary: Order book snapshot for all pairs in Protocol Buffers format

payload.description:
Protocol Buffers encoded message containing order book levels for all available pairs.
Keys are trading pair identifiers in the format `"0x<base_address>/0x<quote_address>"`.
Values contain the current order book levels.

PairLevels.description: Order book levels for a single trading pair.

last_update_ts.description: Timestamp of last price update (milliseconds since epoch).

bids.description: Bid levels ordered by price descending (best bid first). Each level is `[price, size]`.

asks.description: Ask levels ordered by price ascending (best ask first). Each level is `[price, size]`.
